test_case_name: Accept all cookies and verify on sitemap page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the sitemap page
And then check that all cookies are accepted and the cookie banner is dismissed on the sitemap page

test_case_name: Reject cookies and open privacy options on sitemap page

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' on the sitemap page
And then check that the privacy or cookie policy options are displayed on the sitemap page

test_case_name: Close cookie banner on sitemap page

intents.intent: Click the button with id 'cookie-chiudi' on the sitemap page
And then check that the cookie banner is closed on the sitemap page

test_case_name: Use desktop search on sitemap page

intents.intent: Type $name in the input with placeholder 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' on the sitemap page
Click the button with class 'btn-search' on the sitemap page
And then check that the search results for $name are displayed on the sitemap page

test_case_name: Reset desktop search on sitemap page

intents.intent: Click the button with class 'btn-reset-search' on the sitemap page
And then check that the search input is cleared on the sitemap page

test_case_name: Use mobile search on sitemap page

intents.intent: Type $name in the input with placeholder 'Cerca' on the sitemap page
Click the button with class 'btn-search' inside the mobile search form on the sitemap page
And then check that the search results for $name are displayed on the sitemap page

test_case_name: Reset mobile search on sitemap page

intents.intent: Click the button with class 'btn-reset-search' on the sitemap page
And then check that the mobile search input is cleared on the sitemap page

test_case_name: Open guest login and perform login on sitemap page (desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'ENTRA' on the sitemap page
Type $email in the input with placeholder 'E-mail' on the sitemap page
Type $password in the input with placeholder 'Password' on the sitemap page
Click the checkbox labeled 'Mantieni L'accesso' on the sitemap page
Click 'ENTRA' on the sitemap page
And then check that the user is logged in as a guest on the sitemap page
